## Scope

- CI job in `store-infra` that builds both app images, starts the stack and runs Playwright.
- First test: storefront home loads through Caddy and `/health` is 200.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The job runs on pull requests and fails when a service is unhealthy. (pending: first pull request run on GitHub)
- [x] The harness is reusable by the later guest-checkout test.

## Spec

- [Architecture section 4](../../spec/architecture.md)
- [Architecture section 6](../../spec/architecture.md)

## Resolution

Harness: `store-infra/e2e` (Playwright 1.65, Chromium, one worker), workflow `store-infra/.github/workflows/e2e.yml`. The Owner ran both smoke tests against the local dev stack: storefront home through Caddy, and `/health` with Postgres and Redis ok. Both pass.

- The job builds both images, runs `up --wait`, asserts every service is running and not unhealthy (`scripts/assert-stack-up.sh`), runs the tests, then asserts again so a mid-run crash fails the job. Logs and the Playwright report are kept on failure.
- `/health` is read from inside the Compose network (`getFromApiContainer` in `e2e/support/stack.ts`) because Caddy publishes only `/` and `/media/*`. Switch it to a public path once ticket 09's `/api` proxy exposes one.
- Open: the workflow has not run on GitHub. It checks out `store-backend` and `store-frontend` from the same owner and needs a `CHECKOUT_TOKEN` secret if they are private.
